captions.instagram:
Which trade has the slowest website?

We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse on a simulated mid-range phone. Pool builders came last: the median site took 8.1 seconds to show its main content. Solar installers took 7.8 and plumbers 6.5. Electricians and builders were quickest, at 5.6.

Google calls 2.5 seconds good. Even the fastest trade took more than twice that in Google’s lab test.

Which trade has the slowest website?

We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse. Here are the building and home trades, by the median time to show the main content on a simulated mid-range phone:

Pool builders 8.1 s
Solar installers 7.8 s
Kitchen and bathroom renovators 6.9 s
Fencing 6.9 s
Plumbers 6.5 s
Air conditioning 6.4 s
Landscapers 6.2 s
Carpenters 6.0 s
Pest control 5.8 s
Builders 5.6 s
Electricians 5.6 s

Google calls 2.5 seconds good. Even the quickest trade took more than twice that.

It is a lab test with one run per site, so treat it as a warning light, not a verdict. Only groups with 80 or more sites are shown.

If you want to know where your own site sits, I do a free review: prycedigital.com/book
